metadata.title: World Digest — November 13, 2026
metadata.summary: The Supreme Court will hear Trump's border asylum ban while Congo's Ebola outbreak spirals and stocks fell as Nvidia's turmoil deepened.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Trump's Border Asylum Ban Reaches Supreme Court

The Supreme Court agreed to hear a challenge to Trump's executive order suspending asylum at the southern border, setting up a major immigration ruling. AP News

Congo's Ebola Outbreak Spirals Amid Funding Cuts

With over 11,000 cases, Congo's deadliest Ebola epidemic rages unchecked, worsened by USAID cuts and missing funds, per MSF warnings. The New York Times

Russia Demands NATO Retreat in Ukraine Deal Talks

Moscow revived demands for NATO to pull back from Eastern Europe to secure a Ukraine agreement, a non-starter for Finland. The New York Times

Boebert Loses Colorado Seat to Democrat Laubacher

Trump-backed firebrand Lauren Boebert was defeated by Navy veteran Eileen Laubacher in a stunning Colorado congressional upset, per AP projections. The Guardian

US Army Officer Charged with Espionage for Russia

The Army identified Brandon Tyner, an Afghan War veteran, on allegations of spying for Russia following a UK sting operation. Defense News

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Diplomacy and Conflict

Europe agreed on a five-country team to represent it in Ukraine peace talks, while Moscow demanded Europe name an envoy for a seat at the table POLITICO.eu Financial Times. Germany's Merz confirmed Berlin's guaranteed participation in negotiations Financial Times.

US Politics and Security

White House staff now need prior approval to meet lobbyists amid influence-peddling claims, per a Stephen Miller memo Politico. The DOJ instructed agencies to prioritize English over other languages The Hill.

Asia-Pacific

China staged unannounced Pacific drills in "silent intimidation" of Taiwan with 100 ships Reuters. North Korea adopted a revised constitution and modified its flag, reflecting a "two hostile states" policy WSJ.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Slide as Nvidia Turmoil Deepens; Inflation Pressures Persist

S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed lower as Nvidia's uncertainty weighed on tech, with shares suffering their longest weekly losing streak since 2012 Reuters. Wholesale inflation hit a nearly four-year annual high of 6.5% CNN, pressuring the 10-year Treasury yield to 5.17% Bloomberg. Chicago Fed's Goolsbee said the central bank "has definitely got work to do" CNBC. FBI recovered $1.2B in crypto stolen from Binance CBS News. Family Dollar will pay $63M for overcharging CBS News. IEA reports oil market returning to surplus IEA - International Energy Agency.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Apple's HomeView Launches to Mixed Reviews

Apple's $299 HomeView smart display is winning praise for its ecosystem integration, but reviewers flag Siri's limitations and heavy reliance on the iPhone Engadget. The device arrives as Apple also released tvOS 27.2.1, bringing Siri AI to older Apple TVs MacRumors.

iPhone Duo Hinge Fails After 451,000 Folds

CNET's durability test found the iPhone Duo's hinge weakening after three weeks and over 451,000 folds, with resale values dropping 22% amid cracking concerns CNET.

Android XR Smart Glasses Debut at $395

Google and Samsung's Gemini-powered Android XR glasses are now available for pre-order starting at $395, with reviewers praising the companion app over Meta Ray-Bans 9to5Google.

Ocarina of Time Remake Breaks Records

Nintendo's Zelda remake sold 5.2 million units in four days, becoming the fastest-selling Switch 2 game ever Wccftech.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: Johnny Depp's ‘Ebenezer’ took $1.5 million in previews, eyeing a $40 million global opening amid mixed reviews Variety. Russell Brand faces new accusations while imprisoned The Hollywood Reporter. Rosalía made Latin Grammy history with a third best album win BBC, as Dolly Parton's final duet with Bono debuted Rolling Stone. Netflix renewed ‘Virgin River’ for a record ninth season Variety.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Basketball

  • 76ers 123, Raptors 112 — Maxey and Embiid powered Philadelphia without James ESPN.
  • Pistons 144, Wizards 140 — Cade Cunningham’s 52 points sealed a double-overtime thriller ESPN.
  • Timberwolves 133, Mavericks 94 — Minnesota rolled to its most lopsided win of the season ESPN.
  • Dejounte Murray has requested a trade from the Pelicans, per Shams ESPN. Terry Rozier faces new betting allegations from federal prosecutors ESPN.

Hockey

  • Canadiens 5, Bruins 2 — Montreal snapped Boston’s seven-game winning streak ESPN.
  • Senators 4, Avalanche 3 (OT) — Colorado lost MacKinnon and Makar to injury ESPN.
  • Panthers 5, Red Wings 4 — Florida erased a 4-1 deficit on Lundell’s two goals ESPN. Finland’s Russian-athlete block could affect future NHL games there ESPN.

Baseball

  • Jake Bauers agreed to a four-year, $58M deal with the Red Sox ESPN. New Astros manager Brad Ausmus set a World Series goal ESPN.

Football

  • Commanders 24, Giants 21 — Jayden Daniels rallied Washington to stun New York ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Modern Mining Technology priced at $4.25 on NYSE American Yahoo Finance, and vVARDIS Holding at $18 on NYSE Yahoo Finance on 2026-11-13. Upcoming: Bluerock Acquisition and Southport Acquisition on 2026-11-16 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance; Anthropic on 2026-11-19 Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

S&P 500 fell 0.40% to 7,561.67; Dow rose 0.10% to 52,347.55 Yahoo Finance. Nasdaq dropped 0.91% to 25,136.27; Russell 2000 slipped 0.31% Yahoo Finance. VIX jumped 3.21% to 19.30 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Energy led, +1.51% Yahoo Finance. Materials lagged, -1.28%, followed by Communication Services, -0.96%, and Industrials, -0.89% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Nvidia plunged 4.34% to $166.19 Yahoo Finance. Broadcom surged 5.54% to $364.36; Alphabet gained 1.79%; Tesla rose 1.69% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Nvidia was the standout loser among megacaps; Broadcom the top gainer Yahoo Finance. Most actives included Apple and Microsoft, which moved less than 0.4% Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield rose 1.00% to 5.15% Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin fell 3.54% to $71,342.97 Yahoo Finance. Oil edged up 0.20% to $88.92; gold +0.06% to $3,887.60 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24-48 Hours - Markets remain vulnerable: Nvidia's slide and 5.15% 10-year yields may amplify tech volatility. - Watch Supreme Court signals on asylum ban; ruling timing uncertain. - Congo Ebola trajectory likely worsens absent funding—monitor MSF alerts.

Next Week - Anthropic IPO (Nov 19) could shift risk appetite. - Bluerock/Southport IPOs (Nov 16) test IPO market. - Ukraine peace envoy naming may accelerate; Russia's NATO demands likely stall talks.

Next Month - Trump border ruling could reshape immigration policy. - Boebert defeat may signal broader GOP fragility ahead of midterms.
